description: Tracks Gemini token usage and computed USD cost per LoanAgents SmartLoans AI agent invocation, for an admin cost-monitoring dashboard.

fields.name: endpointName
fields.description: LoanAgents FastAPI route that triggered the run, e.g. '/negotiate'.

fields.name: model
fields.description: Model id used for this call, e.g. 'gemini-2.5-flash'.

fields.name: inputTokens
fields.description: Prompt token count for this agent's LLM call.

fields.name: outputTokens
fields.description: Candidate/output token count for this agent's LLM call.

fields.name: thoughtsTokens
fields.description: Thinking token count, when the model reports one.

fields.name: totalTokens
fields.description: Sum of input + output + thoughts tokens.

fields.name: costUsd
fields.description: Computed USD cost for this call, based on the model's per-token pricing.

fields.name: conversationRef
fields.description: Free-form correlation id (e.g. conversationId or session id) for tracing a call back to its request.

components.name: AgentCostDashboardSummaryStep
components.description: Admin dashboard: KPI cards (total cost, total tokens, total requests), a cost-by-agent bar chart, and a daily-cost time series line chart, sourced from the dashboard-summary endpoint.

components.name: AgentCostLogListStep
components.description: Raw log list of individual agent calls with filters by agentName and date range, for drill-down auditing beneath the summary.

endpoints.description: Takes { companyId, startDate?, endDate? }. Aggregates this table GROUP BY agentName (cost, tokens, request count) and GROUP BY day (daily cost time series) for the period. Returns { totalCostUsd, totalTokens, totalRequests, byAgent: [{agentName, costUsd, tokens, requests}], timeSeries: [{date, costUsd}] }. Read-only.

hints: This table is written server-side only, by the LoanAgents SmartLoans FastAPI service (a separate microservice) immediately after each ADK agent run completes — never written directly by the frontend.
sp_agentCostLogs_dashboardSummary aggregates GROUP BY agentName for the cost-by-agent breakdown and GROUP BY CAST(created_At AS DATE) for the time series.
